Authentic Hanoi Boutique Hotel offers fast access to the grand plaza "Ba Dinh Square", nearly 25 minutes' walk away. Boasting a location 750 m from the French Quarter, the 4-star hotel features 36 rooms as well as a restaurant and a shopping area. The hotel lies in the very heart of Gangnam-Gu, which is Seoul's upscale, modern center, home to gleaming skyscrapers, designer brands and stylish nightclubs where big-name DJs spin techno and house, around 30 minutes' walk from the Temple of Literature. Surrounded by greenery, the Authentic Hanoi Boutique is within a few blocks of the famous Hoa Lo Prison. Also, Co Tan Park is situated 800 metres away. If you enjoy visiting historical places, the property offers good access to the circa-1900s Colonial Presidential Palace, which is 2.3 km away. Ha Noi train station can be found within 25 minutes' walk of the Authentic Hanoi Boutique. For your comfort, the luxury rooms come with blackout curtains and air conditioning. They are furnished with sound-proof windows and hardwood flooring, and modern amenities like free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. Also, there is a safe box, a mini fridge bar, coffee and tea makers provided. Guests can take advantage of a bidet and a separate toilet, along with a hair dryer and shower caps supplied in the bathrooms. The rooms at Authentic Hanoi Boutique Hotel also offer luxurious views of the lake. In this Hanoi hotel a delightful kid-friendly buffet breakfast will be waiting for you in the restaurant. Among 2 restaurants onsite, SEN is the one serving Asian dishes. Offering city views, an Asian restaurant is located onsite. Guests can enjoy the lounge bar on premises.
